categories_thin: Water well drilling: still no Piscataway-based driller; the Yellow Pages Middlesex well-drilling results and the NJ Ground Water Association list firms based in Middlesex, North Brunswick and Hillsborough, and most of Piscataway is on public water. Nothing added.

Septic: Piscataway is largely sewered. Only one Piscataway-labelled firm (NJ Septic Designs & Inspections) surfaced; the other septic names returned (Sewer-Man, Atlantic Septic, Central Jersey Septic) either franchise-branded or based outside town, so none were added.

Solar: improved from one entry to three (Amergy, GreenTech Solar USA, Centurion Solar Energy), but all three rest on directory profiles; EnergySage's Piscataway page lists mostly out-of-town installers.

Towing: only two Piscataway-addressed operators confirmed (Musial & Sons, Ted's Towing) plus two names from the township roster with no street address; most towers serving Piscataway are based in neighbouring towns.
Moving and storage: only two firms surfaced for Piscataway and neither shows a street address; local movers in this area are often registered in New Brunswick or Edison.
caveats: All of Piscataway lies within roughly 8-8.5 miles (straight line) of central Milltown, so no part of this zone falls outside the 10-mile radius.

Seven entries from the previous pass were removed on the verifier's findings and my own re-checks: Binsky Home (no Piscataway location - Binsky's main office has moved to Ewing, with Somerset and Langhorne sites), Olympus Construction (54 Powers St is New Brunswick), Aura Home Exteriors (Talmadge Rd is Edison), Greysi and Sons Solutions (no Piscataway base or Piscataway-specific page), Katamount Construction (site and GAF record place it in Middlesex, not 495 Union Ave), Precision Painting Plus of Edison (multi-office brand) and Sciens Building Solutions / Absolute Protective Systems (part of a multi-state fire/security network).

Yellow Pages, BBB, Superpages, BuildZoom, D&B, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com and Cylex all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; their content was used only as returned in search-result snippets, never as if the page had been opened. Entries resting on those snippets should be re-verified by triage.
Google Maps in the browser showed a limited 5-result list view that would not paginate, so map coverage per category is partial.
The Overpass/OpenStreetMap API timed out and was abandoned after one attempt, per brief guidance.

Franchise and chain locations were deliberately excluded: SERVPRO of Piscataway, Paul Davis Restoration of Mid-Central NJ, BELFOR Northern New Jersey, Mavis Discount Tire, Pep Boys, Walmart Tire & Lube, Mr. Rooter, Viking Pest Control, Bin There Dump That, WM, Abbey Carpet and Redi Carpet (regional multifamily flooring supplier).

Many entries are directory-only with no address (marked Unknown); they may be home-based owner-operators, which is typical for this trade sector but means triage must confirm they are real, currently operating businesses. Roughly 28 entries have no street address and roughly 20 have no phone.

Businesses listed only as 'serving Piscataway' by Angi/HomeAdvisor with no Piscataway base shown (e.g. Just In Case Plumbing, Dawson Mechanical, Eddie O's Plumbing, May's Pressure Washing, Lampsi Pools, Deck Guardian, Jersey Decks, SB General Construction, American Eagle Waterproofing, Blue Umbrella Waterproofing, Arid Basement Waterproofing, Basement Gurus, Absolute Waterproofing) were NOT entered as Piscataway businesses; they most likely belong to adjacent zones (Edison, South Plainfield, Metuchen).

A few 'Piscataway' listings look like lead-generation or service-area brands rather than single-location independents (Garage Door Repair Piscataway, Auto Glass & Windshield Replacement of Piscataway, Piscataway Locksmith Corp, Piscataway Towing, Provision Garage Door Repair Piscataway). They are included but flagged for triage screening.

Two pairs share an address and may be related entities: New Age Automotive and Community Auto Service at 424 New Market Rd; Beyond the Leaf and EUC Corporation both appear at 2 Lakeview Ave in directory data.
data_gaps: Township of Piscataway has no public business directory or licensed-contractor list; its economic development page URL returned 404 and no alternate directory was found.
Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce Piscataway directory page rendered almost empty (no member list), so chamber membership could not be harvested.

NJ Division of Consumer Affairs HIC registration lookup and the NJ Licensed Tree Care operator lookup are interactive forms that would require submitting a search; not used, so contractor licence status is unverified for every entry (including Disch's stated LTCO #567, which is the company's own claim).
BBB, D&B and SolarReviews block automated access, so the three solar entries and Ted's Towing could only be recorded from search-result text, not from opened pages.
No street address was obtainable for roughly 28 entries; phone numbers are missing for roughly 20.

Several dozen additional small trades (handymen, one-van landscapers, cleaning services) are almost certainly present in Piscataway but are not discoverable through the directories that were reachable, so this list should be treated as comprehensive for listed businesses but not for unlisted sole proprietors.

The verifier's coverage list referenced 'coverage.missing' but the file supplied contained only the twelve claim-level items; the two tree services and the commercial roofer named in its summary (Disch Tree Experts, Top Quality Tree Service, Badger Roofing) were located and added, but any further names in that list could not be read.
